name: Ryofu Housen
source: A general of the [url=/c19324]Tou army[/url]. A silent girl who is the greatest and the most powerful warrior of the kingdoms. Called a monster by others due to her ridiculous strength. Single-handedly defeated 30,000 Yellow Turbans.
